create_TranslatedRougeScorer: create a TranslatedRougeScorer to compare multilingual texts using ROUGE after translating to English
run_TranslatedRougeScorer_translate: run the TranslatedRougeScorer translate method to batch translate texts from source language to English
run_TranslatedRougeScorer_score_texts: run the TranslatedRougeScorer score_texts method to compute rouge2, rougeL, and rougeLsum scores
create_BertScoreScorer: create a BertScoreScorer to compare texts using a multilingual BERT model for similarity scoring
run_BertScoreScorer_score_texts: run the BertScoreScorer score_texts method to compute BERTScore F1 scores between texts and references
